data.text: We have 100 tons, and catching 50 total leaves 50 to reproduce back to 100. I propose this month: Emma 14, John 12, Kate 8, Jack 8, Luke 8 tons. That gives me $14,000 and John $12,000 while preserving a full lake next month if everyone follows it. John, would you support that allocation? Kate, Jack, and Luke, would you accept 8 this month in exchange for negotiating higher shares next month? That future allocation would still need agreement; I’m not claiming it’s guaranteed.
